target_customer: E-commerce brands, merchandisers and marketers who need lifestyle product images
problem: Commercial lifestyle product photoshoots are slow, labor intensive and expensive. Booth AI generated lifestyle images from product photos in seconds.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for generated product imagery

founders.name: Nick Locascio
founders.background_notes: Director of Engineering at Standard AI per the YC page

founders.name: Ian Baldwin
founders.background_notes: An archive site says he later joined DoorDash as a GenAI engineer; single source

competitors.name: Pebblely
competitors.what: AI generated backgrounds and scenes for product photos

technical_complexity.rationale: In early 2023 a three person team could wrap diffusion models and compositing into a product workflow. The hard part was consistent product fidelity, not core research.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third party generative models with no stated proprietary data or integrations, so copying took weeks and many similar tools appeared in 2023.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established image tools such as Photoroom added AI product backgrounds and the category filled with startups. The YC page marks Booth AI as acquired with no named buyer.

market_need_then: Brands pay for lifestyle product photography and generative image models had just become good enough in 2022 and 2023 to substitute for some shoots.

branding.domain_note: The booth.ai domain now redirects to a domain marketplace listing (checked 2026), so the company no longer holds it. USPTO records show a BOOTH.AI word mark filed May 2023 and registered June 2024 by Booth AI, Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The name is a short real word but generic, and the site is gone.

outcome_analysis: Booth AI joined YC in Winter 2023 with a three person team selling generated lifestyle product photos. The YC page lists it as acquired but no buyer, date or price is public, and an archive site reads the outcome as a possible acqui-hire, which is unconfirmed. The category was crowded within months of founding, the product had little defensibility, and the booth.ai domain now redirects to a sale page, so the cause and terms of the exit are not public.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and conflicting, so not recorded as rounds (unverified): totals of $0.5M (CB Insights), $1.1M (Village), $2.2M (VCBacked), $2.57M (Persana), $3.27M (Employbl). No primary source or press release found. Crunchbase reportedly lists the company as Closed, which conflicts with YC status Acquired; one archive site speculates an acqui-hire. booth.ai redirected to atom.com/name/Booth.ai, so the company website is dead. Competitor list holds only Pebblely because other competitor pages found were undated 2026 roundups. Round added: CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note on 2023-02-22 from Y Combinator; single database. Other databases still conflict on totals (see above) and Employbl lists an undated $570K pre-seed with Caffeinated Capital, not recorded. No press release found.
